item.title: Intro.
item.description: Ponify method uses pose analysis to generate music that reflects a painting’s dynamic perception. It first analyzes human poses to predict a sense of dynamics (SoD), then translates this into musical parameters like tempo and density. The chord progression is based on the painting’s dominant colors, using the Circle of Fifths. The process is fully automated.

item.title: Tempo/Density/Pitch
item.description: These are the sample audios provided to participants to help them understand musical parameters (tempo, pitch, and density) prior to answering the Formative Study questionnaires (Section 3). These audio samples have been created by tweaking the same melody of Mozart’s K.265 (Ah! Vous Dirai-je, Maman) in 3 different parameters using 3 variations (low, normal, high). Participants were able to listen to these audio samples whenever they need to during the survey.
